description: Application for non-material amendment to planning permission ref: PA/18/03162, Dated 10/09/2020.Non-material amendment(s) sought: - Amendments to internal layouts including for fire safety regulations, cycle parking provision, and refuse storage- Removal of commercial floor space on the first floor with existing NIA consolidated at ground floor - Increase in height including residential water supply tank room and smoke shaft AOV on fifth floor roof - Minimal changes to window positions on all elevations to serve revised internal layouts- External render banding to be replaced with light coloured brick- Revision of canal side walkway to raise the pathway and provide level access from the street- Amended conditions 4, 5 and 31
site_name: Site At 65 To 65a, Vyner Street, Adjacent to Regents Canal, London, E2 9DQ
